outcome_evidence: The oven door is closed initially (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot progressively approaches and aligns its gripper with the door handle (frames 170, 250 and 300, image and wrist_image). At frames 350–361, image and wrist_image show the gripper at the handle, but no visible door opening establishes completion. The observed outcome is unconfirmed completion during an ongoing attempt, rather than a clearly failed grasp or pull; no withdrawal after failed acquisition, damage or other local failure is established.
